A project of mine

UNITY / C# / ESP32
HACKATHON PROJECT

RFID platformer

I made a 2D platformer where you scan physical tokens to switch abilities: dash, wall jump, gravity flip, and time stop.

The first version took 2–3 days. You can play it with a keyboard too.

THE CONTROLLER / 01—04

From token to game.

Here’s what happens when I scan a token.

INPUT PATH01 / 04
01Token
RFIDBLUETOOTHUNITY
01 / INPUT

Token

Each physical token stands for one of the game’s four abilities.

02 / SCAN

Reader

An MFRC522 RFID reader scans the token and passes it to the ESP32.

03 / TRANSMIT

Bluetooth key

The ESP32 acts as a Bluetooth keyboard and sends a number key.

04 / IN GAME

Unity

Unity receives that key and selects the ability.
